sections.title: Describing a Resulting State: van/volt + Preverb + -va/-ve
sections.content: When Hungarian combines the copula van / volt / lesz with a transitive verb's -va/-ve participle (almost always carrying a telic preverb such as meg-, be-, ki-, le-, el-), it forms the Stative Resultative Construction. Crucially, this does NOT describe the ongoing act of someone performing the action right now; instead, it describes the visible state resulting from an already completed change: A kupola be van aranyozva ('The dome is gilded' — state), A képek ki vannak állítva a galériában ('The paintings are on display in the gallery'). Notice that in neutral focus, the preverb precedes van/volt: meg van világítva ('is illuminated'), nincs aláírva ('is not signed').

sections.title: Contrast with Dynamic Mediopassive (-ódik/-ődik)
sections.content: If you want to describe a process unfolding before your eyes ('is taking shape', 'is being reflected', 'is blurring'), you cannot use van + -va/-ve; you must use an inchoative/mediopassive verb in -ódik/-ődik or -ul/-ül: A fák körvonalai élesen kirajzolódnak a vízben ('The contours of the trees stand out / are being etched sharply in the water' — process) vs. A terv már fel van vázolva ('The plan is already sketched out' — completed result).

sections.title: Completed Result (van + -va/-ve) vs. Unfolding Process (-ódik/-ődik)
rows: A festmény restaurálva van / meg van tisztítva. (Resulting state)
The painting is restored / has been cleaned.
A ciprusok képe a vízben tükröződik. (Ongoing visual process)
The image of the cypresses is reflected / shimmers in the water.
A kapu nem volt bezárva, csak behajtva. (Resulting state)
The gate was not locked, only pulled shut.
Az alkonyatban lassan elmosódnak a határok. (Unfolding change)
In the twilight, the boundaries gradually blur.

items.spanish: A liliomok úgy ragyogtak, mintha belülről lettek volna megvilágítva.
items.english: The lilies glowed as if they had been illuminated from within.

items.spanish: Ez a titokzatos portré nincs aláírva, így az alkotó kiléte ma is vitatott.
items.english: This mysterious portrait is not signed, so the artist's identity remains disputed today.

items.spanish: A márványkút vizében élesen kirajzolódtak az éjszakai égbolt csillagai.
items.english: In the water of the marble fountain, the stars of the night sky stood out sharply.

items.spanish: A legértékesebb vázlatok páncélszekrényben vannak elzárva a múzeumban.
items.english: The most valuable sketches are locked away in a vault in the museum.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Watch the word order in neutral affirmative clauses: `[Preverb] + [van/volt/vannak] + [verb-va/-ve]` ('Ki van állítva', 'Meg volt világítva'), whereas in negation 'nincs/nem volt' comes first ('Nincs befejezve').
